content.short: Goat Protocol is a decentralized yield optimizer helping users earn compound interest on crypto assets.
content.description: DeFi platforms often feel complex and intimidating to newcomers. Goat Protocol makes the process simpler by providing approachable, intuitive interfaces and automated strategies that make participating in DeFi feasible for users with limited experience. With simple staking, you can set up auto-compounding for your yield-bearing positions, letting your tokens work for you without needing deep technical know-how or hands-on management. No prior knowledge or experience in DeFi is required.
